rows.interpretation: (1) Round-2 #19 names five items (purpose, tool or model, vendor, users, status and date); `content_data` is not among them, and the #19 option itself says the data item has no activity counterpart and still needs a question. (5) Contact sub-items: no wording change. rows.diff: {+| CX-61b (new) | `discontinued_uncertain` (incident item only) | The page suggests that this activity may have been ended, cancelled or suspended, but does not confirm it. |+}
rows.interpretation: (1) Definition adapted from the v2.5 uncertainty flag it replaces ('Activity may have been discontinued but cannot confirm', contract §4.10), with 'discontinued' spelled out from the `discontinued` stage definition ('ended, cancelled, or suspended'). (2) Spelling: I reused the v2.5 flag token `discontinued_uncertain` for the translation table; the rulings say 'discontinuation uncertain'. Spelling is the PI's. (3) OPEN, not drafted: CX-61 is a single Choice with no tie-break. A page can report a quantified incident and also leave discontinuation uncertain; the PI must place this value in an order (or rule it separate), and decide whether a confirmed discontinuation is an incident at all (the `discontinued` stage already records it).
